Since K is skew-adjoint under the positive-mass L² scalar product, its two nonzero singular values coincide and −trace(K²)/2=z(1−z)=h²; h∈(0,1/2]. All x,y∈(0,1) arise from positive masses. At z=z±, x=y=√z− attains the lower envelope, z=z+ makes e=2z+ identically, and continuous x∈(z,1), y=z/x connects every interior endpoint value on z−. At h=1/2 interval is singleton e=1. Two-point spaces have only commuting conditional expectations. Independent rational checks on 512 mass triples confirmed the matrix identities.
